pages.text: Drinks a bucket of lava at a time and burns it at $(o)90 FE/t$() for 1,400 ticks. Slower to feed than coal, and far denser per trip.$(br2)The bucket is a container, not a consumable: it comes back empty in the slot, ready to be pulled out and refilled.$(br2)Its buffer holds 120,000 FE and it gives out up to 800 FE/t.
